description.zh:
版本类型，取值：

- **FOTA**：系统版本
- **APP**：应用版本
description.en:
The version type. Valid values:

- **FOTA**: system version.
- **APP**: application version.

title.zh: 给某一版本下的所有机型推送升级消息
title.en: Push upgrade message to all device models under a version

descriptions.zh:
> 只能给“预发布”，“已发布”状态的版本推送消息。

- 针对系统版本推送，因为系统版本只关联一个机型，会对该机型下所有设备推送升级消息。
- 针对应用版本推送，则会对应用版本下的所有关联机型覆盖的设备推送升级消息。
descriptions.en:
> You can push messages only to versions in the "Pre-release" or "Published" status.

- For system version pushes, because a system version is associated with only one device model, the upgrade message is pushed to all devices under that device model.
- For application version pushes, the upgrade message is pushed to devices covered by all device models associated with the application version.
